about: Real players' newest twenty games from the shard's match-history server (one Tencent shard, patches 16.18-16.19, 2026-10-06), for calibrating winer's recent strength (crates/core/src/rating.rs). Nothing identifies a player or a game: no names, puuids, game ids or times. `aram` holds 40 players met in Hextech ARAM, `rift` 30 met in Summoner's Rift games; each player is a list of games, newest first, `me` the player's line in `lines`. `kind` is the queue's kind in the client's catalog (matched, custom, bots).
